user.title: SH Auto Update Manager
user.description:
Set up the Auto Update Manager by Smarter Homes LLC (smarter.homes).

This integration discovers all available Home Assistant updates, groups them by integration type, and installs them with per-group execution modes, manual approval, and safety overrides.

After setup, configure per-group rules in the integration options.

abort.already_configured: SH Auto Update Manager is already configured.

init.title: Global Settings
init.description: Configure general queue behavior, timing, and maintenance window.

data.auto_start: Auto-start queue when updates are discovered
data.zwave_mains_only: Z-Wave: mains-powered devices only (skip battery devices)

data_description.auto_start: When enabled, the queue automatically starts processing when new updates are found during a refresh scan. When disabled, you must manually press 'Update All Eligible' to start.
data_description.zwave_mains_only: Skip battery-powered Z-Wave devices. Battery devices may stall during firmware updates if asleep.
data_description.install_delay: Wait time between consecutive installs (0-300 seconds).
data_description.install_timeout: Maximum time to wait for a single update to complete (60-14400 seconds).
data_description.maintenance_window_start: Updates will only run between start and end times (24h format, e.g. 02:00).
data_description.maintenance_window_end: Updates will only run between start and end times (24h format, e.g. 05:00).

group_modes.title: Per-Group Execution Modes
group_modes.description:
Choose how updates in each group are processed.

- **sequential**: one at a time, wait for each to finish
- **parallel**: all at once (safe for independent updates)
- **disabled**: skip entirely, never auto-update
- **manual_only**: show in queue but require explicit approval

Note: Z-Wave and HA Core/OS are always forced sequential for safety, even if set to parallel.

filters.title: Exclusion Filters
filters.description: Exclude specific entities, areas, or labels from the update queue.

data_description.exclude_entities: Comma-separated list of update entity IDs to always skip (e.g., update.my_device_firmware).
data_description.exclude_areas: Comma-separated list of area IDs to exclude.
data_description.exclude_labels: Comma-separated list of labels to exclude.
